purpose: Region-defining skilling activities, reward shops, outfits, off-hands, tool chains, and production infrastructure for Equilibrium no-trading planning.

policy.region_rule: region_hint marks where the unlock or activity lives in the current planner taxonomy. region_hints marks a cross-region chain. Quest auto-completion and League-specific overrides must be applied separately.
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise unlocks that materially change self-sufficient progression, training throughput, supply access, or tool progression. Do not mirror every shop item.
policy.rate_rule: Do not promote stale XP/hour figures. Training rates belong in training datasets; this file records unlock state and effects.

records.name: Prifddinas skilling hub
records.detail: Prifddinas is far more than one training method. Treat it as a bundle of tool, shop, production, and high-level skilling unlocks when valuing Tirannwn. · Equilibrium explicitly advertises Prifddinas as Tirannwn content and says region quest completion is intended to provide immediate access. Keep any individual item skill requirements. · Unlocks: Ithell harmonium harps and harmonic dust, Trahaearn Seren stones and corrupted ore, Meilyr combination-potion infrastructure, Waterfall Fishing and crystal fishing rod shop, district skilling services and Voice of Seren rotations · Region status: confirmed_official_region_example

records.name: Crystal tool and harmonic dust infrastructure
records.detail: Lady Ithell upgrades several dragon-tier tools with harmonic dust. Crystal pickaxes, hatchets, mattocks, fishing rods, tinderboxes and hammers also feed augmentable skilling progression. · Tirannwn supplies the crystal side of several late-game tool chains. Do not imply the other components of those chains are Tirannwn-only. · Unlocks: Crystal pickaxe, Crystal hatchet, Crystal mattock, Crystal tool-seed utility, Attuned crystal teleport seed, Harmonium harps as a low-attention harmonic-dust source

source.title: Crystal tool and harmonic dust infrastructure

records.name: Waterfall Fishing and Fishing Shop
records.category: Fishing activity and permanent tool unlock
records.detail: The crystal fishing rod is 5% more likely to catch fish and can be augmented. This makes Waterfall Fishing a permanent tool unlock as well as a training activity. · Keep the rod unlock even if Equilibrium XP multipliers make another fishing method faster. · Unlocks: Crystal urchin points, Ability to make the crystal fishing rod for 3,000 crystal urchin points
requirements: 93 Fishing for the high-level Waterfall Fishing route
90 Agility, Ranged and Strength for the waterfall route in the normal game

records.name: Meilyr Recipe Shop and combination potions
records.detail: Some combination-potion recipes are purchased directly once requirements are met; others first need recipe discovery from Daemonheim or another source. Do not hard-code Forinthry as a requirement for every Meilyr recipe. · Tirannwn is the shop and production hub. Recipe-specific discovery dependencies remain separate. · Unlocks: Combination-potion recipes, Recipe Shop purchase step, Access to Meilyr Herblore services · Region status: confirmed_base_game_geography

source.title: Meilyr Recipe Shop and combination potions

records.name: Crystal sandstone and crystal flasks
records.detail: Crystal sandstone is the local Prifddinas supply for crystal flasks. The 2026 DailyScape overhaul removed the old daily mining cap, so old daily-cap advice must not be used. · This is a major no-trading production unlock because it controls self-supplied combination-potion containers. · Unlocks: Crystal glass, Crystal flasks, Six-dose combination-potion containers
requirements: 81 Mining for crystal-flecked sandstone in the normal game
89 Crafting for crystal flasks in the normal game

records.name: Motherlode Maw and Meilyr resource dungeons
records.detail: The Maw is a high-level Prifddinas reward source and can also help with otherwise awkward unlocks such as Meilyr potion recipes. · The activity lives in Tirannwn, but its 115 Dungeoneering requirement means Forinthry can still be a practical cross-region dependency in Equilibrium. · Unlocks: Motherlode Maw daily reward, Edimmu resource dungeon, Meilyr crystal sandstone access, Useful enhancers and high-level skilling rewards
requirements: 115 Dungeoneering for the Motherlode Maw resource dungeon
95 in normal skills for Maw rewards, including Necromancy

source.title: Motherlode Maw and Meilyr resource dungeons

records.name: Seren stones and corrupted ore
records.category: AFK Mining and Smithing supply loop
records.detail: Seren stones are a durable Prifddinas skilling unlock even when they are not the absolute fastest Mining route. They matter for low-input training and self-supplied Smithing experience. · Keep this as a utility and AFK route, separate from pure XP/hour rankings. · Unlocks: Corrupted ore, High-attention-free Mining route, Corrupted-ore Smithing experience

records.name: Artisans' Workshop Reward Shop
records.detail: Blacksmith outfit pieces cost respect at the Reward Shop. Luminite injectors overload the workshop and add progress per smithing swing for players in the workshop. · This is a real Asgarnia skilling unlock bundle, not just the burial-smithing training method. · Unlocks: Blacksmith's outfit, up to 6% Smithing XP, Luminite injector, Ceremonial sword reward upgrades, Cannon upgrade progression

records.name: Deep Sea Fishing hub
records.detail: Fishing Frenzy is already tracked as the high-XP route. The hub also adds lower-input food gathering, swarm fishing, a rotating merchant, and the rare Tavia's fishing rod acquisition path. · Merchant stock and currency practicality should be launch-checked, but hub access itself is a major Kandarin unlock. · Unlocks: Fishing Frenzy at 94+, Sailfish at 97+, Swarm fishing, Travelling Merchant access, Deep Sea Fishing boosts and events

records.name: Farmers' Market and master farmer outfit
records.category: Farming reward shop and elite outfit
records.detail: The master farmer outfit is an important permanent Farming progression target. Its animal-farming benefits include increased beans when selling animals. · No-trading increases the value of bean-shop and self-sufficient farm unlocks. · Unlocks: Master farmer outfit blueprint, Animal, crop and tree farmer outfit progression, Player-Owned Farm reward-shop upgrades
requirements: 1,000 beans for the master farmer outfit blueprint
80 Farming and 20 Invention to manufacture outfit pieces

source.title: Farmers' Market and master farmer outfit

records.name: Pyramid Plunder and black ibis outfit
records.detail: Do not import old black-ibis drop-rate tables into League planning. The permanent outfit unlock is what matters here. · Treat this as Desert skilling progression even if a faster raw-XP Thieving method is available elsewhere. · Unlocks: Black ibis outfit, Up to 5% Thieving XP with the full set

source.title: Pyramid Plunder and black ibis outfit

records.name: Red sandstone and potion flasks
records.detail: Red sandstone at Oo'glog and Sophanem feeds potion-flask production. The 2026 DailyScape overhaul removed the old daily cap, and July 2026 reduced rock hitpoints. · This is the Desert half of high-end six-dose flask infrastructure; crystal flasks for combination potions are a separate Tirannwn unlock. · Unlocks: Robust glass, Potion flasks

records.name: Temple Trekking skilling outfits
records.detail: Temple Trekking is worth surfacing as permanent skilling progression, not just a minigame, because it owns two useful XP outfits. · Resolve normal quest access through the Equilibrium auto-quest overlay before treating the trek itself as manually gated. · Unlocks: Constructor's outfit, up to 6% Construction XP, Lumberjack outfit, 5% Woodcutting XP

records.name: Lava Flow Mine skilling unlocks
records.detail: Keldagrim's Lava Flow Mine is the normal-game source for the golden mining suit and the Imcando-pickaxe branch of late-game Mining tool progression. · Keldagrim is treated as Fremennik-region geography. Resolve quest auto-completion separately. · Unlocks: Golden mining suit, 6% Mining XP with the full set, Gilded dragon pickaxe step, Imcando pickaxe fragments from lava geysers

records.name: Tier 3 Woodcutter's Grove and Imcando hatchet fragments
records.detail: After tier 3 Grove is built, Imcando-hatchet fragments can appear in bird nests from Woodcutting. This makes Fort progression a permanent Woodcutting tool gate. · The repo currently maps Fort Forinthry to Misthalin using Catalyst precedent. Keep that mapping provisional until Equilibrium confirms it. · Unlocks: Imcando hatchet fragment nests from Woodcutting, One guaranteed first fragment from Oak, Bad-luck mitigation on fragment nests · Region status: historical_fort_working_taxonomy
requirements: Tier 3 Woodcutter's Grove in the normal game

source.title: Tier 3 Woodcutter's Grove and Imcando hatchet fragments

records.name: Ghostly sole fishing
records.detail: The spot does not move, making ghostly soles a useful low-input City of Um route and a practical place to level augmented fishing gear. · City of Um is currently a historical Misthalin working mapping, not an Equilibrium-specific locality confirmation. · Unlocks: Stationary ghostly sole fishing spot, 130 base Fishing XP per catch · Region status: historical_city_of_um_working_taxonomy

records.name: Daemonheim skilling reward infrastructure
records.category: Dungeoneering reward shop and utility unlocks
records.detail: Equilibrium explicitly places Daemonheim in Forinthry, so Dungeoneering reward-store items are a real regional dependency in a no-trading planner. · Do not assume reward-token costs are altered unless Equilibrium publishes a multiplier or passive. · Unlocks: Bonecrusher, Charming imp, Herbicide, Gem bag and upgraded gem bag, Smithing autoheater upgrades, Scroll and utility rewards used by skilling chains · Region status: confirmed_official

records.name: Crystal fishing rod
records.detail: A major permanent Fishing tool unlock even when Fishing Frenzy or another activity is better raw XP. · Effects: 5% more likely to catch fish at compatible fishing spots, Can be augmented for Invention perks

records.name: Tavia's fishing rod
records.detail: Record as a rare ceiling item, not baseline Kandarin power. A player cannot plan around obtaining it quickly. · Rarity: hero_item_very_rare · Effects: 10% increased fishing success rate when compatible, Can trigger all three Deep Sea Fishing boosts, Can be augmented
requirements: Rare red uncharted island map from Deep Sea Fishing or Travelling Merchant route

records.name: Trahaearn exoskeleton
records.detail: Prifddinas/Tirannwn is the useful regional value. Resolve the quest through Equilibrium auto-completion before treating it as a manual requirement. · Effects: 25% chance to avoid being stunned and damaged while pickpocketing, 25% chance to avoid snake bites in Pyramid Plunder, Can inherit black ibis experience benefits once those are owned
requirements: Plague's End reward in the normal game

records.name: Sana's fyrtorch
records.detail: Use the canonical item name. The existing loose major-upgrade row used a non-item placeholder name for this reward. · Region status: historical_senntisten_working_taxonomy

records.name: Tagga's corehammer
records.detail: Use the canonical item name. The critical-strike bonuses remain useful outside core ores; only the arrow-tip effect is core-ore specific. · Effects: +10% Mining critical strike chance, +35% Mining critical strike damage, Chance for deathspore arrow tips from core ores · Region status: historical_senntisten_working_taxonomy

records.name: Memory dowser
records.detail: City of Um/Gate is currently mapped to Misthalin by historical League precedent pending Equilibrium confirmation. · Effects: Gather memories from wisps up to 7 tiles away, Supports ranged, low-movement Divination gathering · Region status: historical_city_of_um_working_taxonomy

records.name: Runic attuner
records.detail: Use the post-29-September-2025 effect, not the original release tooltip. Do not assume it is always the best XP/hour route; altar sequence and Soul altar use matter. · Effects: Attunes to eligible Runecrafting altars, At 1-49 energy, attuned-altar crafting gains 200% additional Runecrafting XP, Every 5 energy gives a 50% rune multiplier at the attuned altar, Every 7 energy allows choosing an altar, Every 10 energy grants an attuned-altar teleport, Every 25 energy guarantees 1-4 magical thread, At 50 energy, attuned-altar crafting gains 2,400% additional Runecrafting XP and resets energy · Region status: historical_city_of_um_working_taxonomy

records.name: Orthen furnace core
records.detail: Track the unlock, but do not label it BIS for pure XP. Its situational effects can lose to augmented off-hands and other setups.

records.name: Imcando pickaxe
records.detail: Do not use historical enchanted-Imcando bonus-XP data. The enchanted variant was removed in 2019.
requirements: Golden mining suit before gilding a dragon pickaxe

records.name: Pickaxe of Earth and Song
records.detail: Treat Fremennik plus Tirannwn as the normal self-sufficient chain unless Equilibrium adds alternate tool sources. · Region pressure: Imcando pickaxe progression comes from the Keldagrim/Lava Flow Mine chain., Crystal pickaxe progression comes from Prifddinas crystal-tool infrastructure.

records.name: Imcando hatchet
records.detail: Use the Fort's current working Misthalin taxonomy until Equilibrium publishes a different boundary. · Region status: historical_fort_working_taxonomy
requirements: Imcando hatchet fragments from bird nests

records.name: Skeka's hypnowand
records.detail: Do not label this Anachronia-only. The Daemonheim journal gate is a real Forinthry dependency in the normal acquisition path. · Region pressure: Forinthry owns Daemonheim and the Warped Depths journal gate., Pieces then come from Anachronia activities including Big Game Hunter, Rex Matriarchs, vile blooms and the Agility Course.
requirements: Read the aged journal in the Warped Depths of the Daemonheim Dig Site before pieces can drop

records.name: Balarak's sash brush
records.detail: Surface both Forinthry and Anachronia in planner dependencies. · Effects: +5% excavation success rate, +5% mattock base precision, 10% chance for an additional material while excavating, 5% chance for Chronal Focus at 100% sprite focus · Region pressure: Brush pieces come from the Warped Depths of the Daemonheim Dig Site., The damaged brush is shown to Sharrigan outside Anachronia Base Camp to learn restoration.

records.name: Artificer's measure
records.category: Crafting and Construction skilling off-hand cross-region chain
records.detail: Do not hard-require every listed region. Crystal sandstone has an alternate Ports source and quest auto-completion can change the mould route, but region choices strongly affect self-sufficient acquisition. · Effects: Stores gems like the upgraded gem bag, Always applies the Ithell Voice of Seren harp benefit while playing harps, 5% chance to duplicate glassblown items and urns, including potion and crystal flasks, Scroll of proficiency chance multiplied by 1.25, Crafting/Construction buff can stack to 5% after proficiency procs
requirements: Chain link mould from the Legacy of Seergaze route
Crystal-flecked sandstone or an alternate player-owned ports source
